patches.note: wrong-number: strength 122 was the 107th New York's; MacThomson's report (OR 27/1 p.304) gives 230 men and 25 officers = 255 engaged, so the 165 losses of the return (p.173) are 64.7 percent, not 135.2

patches.repl: The return's 242 casualties for this regiment occurred at Fairfield, Pa. (OR 27/1 p.185 footnote), not on the Gettysburg field. No casualty rate is given: the strength shown (226) is the figure this record carries and no report held here gives the regiment's strength at Fairfield. The sources also differ on the loss: Lieutenant Nolan counts 290 enlisted men killed, wounded and missing there (OR 27/1 p.948) against the return's 242."
patches.note: impossible-rate: 242 losses (Fairfield) over a strength of 226 printed 107.1 percent; the strength at Fairfield is in no source held, and Nolan (OR 27/1 p.948) differs from the return, so no rate is given and the record says why
